title: Open base-change restriction for single modules in any integer degree
statement: Fix shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let f:X→S, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′ form a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let G be an arbitrary O_X-module and n any integer. Let V⊆S, W⊆S′ be open with W⊆g⁻¹V, and put U=f⁻¹V, fA=f|V, gA=g|W, H=G|U, P=U×_V W, p:P→U and q:P→W. Write M(n) for the complex with M in degree n and zero elsewhere, and R for exact derived restriction to W [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. A comparison at (k,M,n) means the component at M(n) of a witnessing left-derived tensor-pullback counit, followed by the termwise single-complex identification with (k*_tensor M)(n) [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. For any such comparisons c at (g′,G,n) and c0 at (p,H,n), there exist isomorphisms a:R(Lg*Rf*(G(n)))≅LgA*RfA*(H(n)) and b:R(Rf′*((g′*_tensor G)(n)))≅Rq*((p*_tensor H)(n)) such that R(β≫Rf′*(c))≫b=a≫(βA≫Rq*(c0)), where β and βA are the chosen derived base-change mates [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No flatness, affineness, properness or nonemptiness is assumed. The degree n is universally quantified, and both comparison witnesses are explicit in Lean.

source.place: Tag 08HY (derived counit and base-change mate); Tag 08FE (restriction of derived direct image); Tag 08IB (locality); Tag 0D5U (exact extension by zero). The single-complex argument applies in every integer degree.

proof.text: Construct the reference single-degree comparison directly from the composition-pinned counit. Its witnessing counit and left-derived property are the recorded composition data. This is the proved private pinned_comparison_isComparison helper; no ordinary-to-tensor adjunction comparison is needed.
Apply the arbitrary-degree target-automorphism theorem to the pinned and arbitrary witnessing comparisons at g′ and G, and at p and H. Obtain module automorphisms α,γ with c=c₁≫α[n] and c0=c₂≫γ[n].
Specialize the natural pinned geometric square to G, taking a.app G and b.app G.

Map α[n] through derived direct image and restriction to an automorphism A of the original ordinary target. Map γ[n] through derived direct image to an automorphism B of the restricted target. Keep a.app G and replace b.app G by A inverse followed by b.app G followed by B. Functoriality, associativity and hom-inverse cancellation turn the reference square into the asserted square. Apply congrArg to postcompose the pinned square by B.hom. Mathlib Functor.map_comp, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc and Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc simplify the asserted conjugated square to this equality; there is no duplicate conjugateSquare declaration and no hole in this combination.

theorem restricted_base_change_compatibility_single_degree
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (G : X.Modules) (n : ℤ)
    (c : (derivedPullback g').obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))
    (hc : (∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh.{w} ⋙ derivedPullback g' ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh.{w} (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
              (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)),
        (derivedPullback g').IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
          c = ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor _ n).obj G) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Qh.{w}.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
              ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
                (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g') (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).hom.app G))))
    (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let fA := f ∣_ V
    let gA := g.resLE V W hWV
    let H := (schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj G
    let E := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj G
    let E0 := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj H
    let R := (schemeOpenRestriction S' W).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ (c0 : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj E0 ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) n).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj H))
    (hc0 : (∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh.{w} ⋙ derivedPullback (pullback.fst fA gA) ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).mapHomotopyCategory
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh.{w} (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
              (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)),
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
          c0 = ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor _ n).obj H) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Qh.{w}.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
              ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
                (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA))
                  (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).hom.app H)))),
      ∃ a : R.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)) ≅
          (derivedPullback gA).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage fA).obj E0),
      ∃ b : R.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj G))) ≅
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback fA gA).toRingedSpace)) n).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst fA gA)).obj H)),
        R.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w E ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map c) ≫ b.hom =
          a.hom ≫
            (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap fA (pullback.snd fA gA) gA (pullback.fst fA gA)
              pullback.condition E0 ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd fA gA)).map c0)
